description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.htmlParser.fragment class, which represents a lightweight HTML DOM structure and includes methods for parsing HTML strings into fragments, manipulating nodes, and outputting HTML. It is part of the CKEditor HTML parser core.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.fragment
classes.description: Represents a lightweight HTML DOM fragment with methods for parsing, node management, and HTML output.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.fragment.fromHtml
methods.description: Creates a fragment from an HTML string, with optional fixing for body content.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a node (element, text, or comment) to the fragment.

methods.name: writeHtml
methods.description: Outputs the fragment's HTML to a writer, with optional filtering.

methods.name: writeChildrenHtml
methods.description: Outputs the HTML of the fragment's children to a writer.
